_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'blackthorn_scar' (Blackthorn Scar). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

lantern_keeper_rosa.name: Rosa of Last Lantern
lantern_keeper_rosa.greeting: As long as the lantern burns, the Scar doesn't take the village. It's very important you don't sneeze on it.

penitent_jory.name: Jory the penitent
penitent_jory.greeting: I joined the cult by mistake. I thought it was a baking club.

outrider_garrick.name: Outrider Garrick
outrider_garrick.greeting: Their stockade. My vantage. Their arrows. My problem.

quests.name: Into the Scar
quests.offer: Redcliff sent you. The warband that burns the frontier answers to something that lives at the heart of the Scar. Clear the way to it.
quests.done: The way is open. Gather everyone you can find. It wakes when the lantern dims.

quests.name: The Heart of the Scar
quests.group: world boss — everyone in the province is called
quests.offer: Every soul in the province should be here when it rises. Stand with them. Do not stand in the red.

steps.text: The province's world boss defeated (event credit counts)

quests.done: The Scar is quiet. The lantern burns. Torbor Downs is safe, for now. Thank you.

quests.name: Not a Baking Club
quests.offer: The cult took my recipe book. Grandmother's scones. Get it back from the zealots, and maybe burn their real book while you're there.
quests.done: My scones! Truly the light returns to the world.

quests.name: Crawlers in the Pits
quests.offer: Ossuary crawlers in the bone pits. Kill them before the warband teaches them tricks.
quests.done: Fewer crawlers. Fewer nightmares. Same number of arrows.

quests.name: Barrows of the Scar
quests.offer: The warband stores its loot in the old barrow maze. It's guarded by worse things than the warband.
quests.done: You came out. That's more than the warband expected.

quests.name: The Thorn-Stalker
quests.offer: Something stalks the edge of the lantern-light. It is patient. Be less patient.
quests.done: The edge of the light is a little further out tonight.
